message.content: {"choice":"KILL THIS ONE","reason":"This is a plain terminal checklist with an off-brand green glow and none of the magical 3D transformation the owner rewards in Higgsfield shots. The owner already killed the earlier terminal-based shot and other flat ones."}
message.reasoning:
I'm weighing this Higgsfield shot against what the owner has already rejected. They killed the "terminal becomes Paris at night" concept and the other plain, non-magical cards, and this one is a simple terminal with a green glow, which feels off-brand and dull. The owner clearly responds to magical 3D work, so I'm leaning toward killing it, though editing it is still on the table.

I'm leaning toward killing this one since it doesn't play to Higgsfield's strengths; the good shots were magical transformations, and a plain terminal is neither magical nor on-brand.
